children: and the London Metal Exchange have been named as defendants in a new claim by hedge fund Elliott over the cancellation of nickel trades in 2022, Hong Kong's bourse operator said on Tuesday.
HKEX said it has not been served with the claim and that Elliott must first obtain permission from the UK Competition Appeal Tribunal to serve proceedings.
